prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: angry eye animation atlas for the same 64x64 pixel-art portrait
Input image: Image 1 is the inspected local eyes-reference-grid.png; use it as the only reference.
Primary request: Make one complete 2x2 eye atlas. Four full upper-face cells, row-major open, half closed, closed, open. Preserve original 64x35 half aspect and clean cell boundaries.
Keep: same woman, fixed eye positions and widths, fixed olive-green irises, fixed pupils and iris highlights, source hairline, nose bridge, background, soft tan-brown skin, low-contrast pixel texture. Across blink phases, lids cover the same eyeballs vertically; never move, shrink, widen or round the irises. Keep lowered angry brows and stationary creases identical in all four cells. Repeat the first open pose exactly in the last cell.
Correct only palette and detail drift: use source muted tan/brown skin, soft medium-brown brows, subdued warm ivory eye highlights. Give brows restrained angry tension by lowering them toward the nose; keep their original pixel-scale thickness and natural brown color. Keep both eyes anatomically the same size and shape as reference.
Composition: exact 2x2 cell arrangement, no padding, no borders, no text, full cells.
Avoid: bright white eye flashes, near-black or heavy brows, orange skin, blue or cyan pixels, stray edge marks, face redesign, full-face inserts, mouth or lower-face, new objects, smoothing, blur, antialiasing, color grading, iris shifts, changing iris geometry, partial cells.
